title: What is Zynkrit
content: Zynkrit is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for boutique CA (Chartered Accountant), CS (Company Secretary), and Law firms in India. It replaces Excel and WhatsApp workflows with a unified workspace for managing clients, staff, compliance deadlines, tasks, challan tracking, service pricing, and GST-compliant invoicing. The design tagline is "Bloomberg Terminal meets Linear" — precise, fast, zero noise.

title: Target user roles at a firm
content: Zynkrit has four staff roles per firm: Partner/Admin has full access and manages firm settings, billing, and staff. Manager assigns tasks and views all clients. Associate works on tasks and views only assigned clients. Intern can only view their own tasks. Firm types using the platform include CA firms (GST, ITR, TDS, audit), Company Secretaries (MCA, ROC, DIR), Law firms (court dates, matters), or multi-discipline combinations of these.

title: Module system and gating rules
content: Every firm has 1 to 3 practice modules active: CA (GST, ITR, TDS, Advance Tax), CS (MCA, ROC, DIR filings), and LEGAL (court dates, matters, litigation). A SaaS admin toggles which modules a firm has — firms cannot change this themselves. The critical architectural rule is that there is only ever one dashboard, one calendar, and one Kanban board — never separate UIs per module. Every relevant record has a module_type field, and the UI filters by chip/tag rather than routing to separate pages per module.

title: Frontend technology stack
content: Zynkrit's frontend uses Next.js 14 with the App Router, TypeScript 5.x, Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui components, TanStack Query 5.x for server state, FullCalendar.io 6.x for the calendar UI, dnd-kit for drag-and-drop (used only in the Kanban board), and Tabler Icons in outline style at 1.5px stroke width (never mixed with other icon styles).

title: Backend and infrastructure technology stack
content: Zynkrit's backend uses Fastify 4.x on Node.js, Zod 3.x for validation, Prisma 5.x as the ORM, and PostgreSQL 16 with Row-Level Security (RLS) for multi-tenancy. Redis and BullMQ handle caching and background job queues. Email is sent via Mailpit locally (localhost:8025) and Resend in production. File storage uses UTHO Object Storage in production and the local filesystem in development. The monorepo is managed with Turborepo and pnpm 9.x.

title: Monorepo folder structure
content: Zynkrit is a Turborepo/pnpm monorepo. apps/web is the Next.js staff dashboard with app-router routes grouped under (staff) for authenticated pages (dashboard, clients, tasks, calendar, challans, invoices, staff, settings) plus public login and invite routes. apps/api is the Fastify REST API with modules for auth, firms, staff, clients, tasks, calendar, challans, pricing, invoices, and documents; plus middleware (tenant resolver, RBAC, module gating), jobs (BullMQ reminders and crons), and lib (prisma.ts, redis.ts, mailer.ts, storage.ts). packages/db holds the Prisma schema, migrations, and seed data; packages/types holds shared TypeScript types used by both web and api; packages/config holds shared ESLint/Prettier/TS config. infra/ contains docker-compose.yml for local dev services (PostgreSQL, Redis, Mailpit, Meilisearch) and Helm charts for production Kubernetes.

title: Database schema overview (all 23 tables)
content: Zynkrit's PostgreSQL 16 database (with Row-Level Security for multi-tenancy) has 23 tables covering firm/tenant setup, staff and client records, module-specific client profiles (CA/CS/Legal), compliance tracking, tasks, challans and credit notes, service pricing, GST invoicing and payments, document storage, and an immutable audit log. The full table list is: firms, firm_module_configs, firm_settings, users, staff_profiles, clients, client_ca_profiles, client_cs_profiles, client_legal_profiles, legal_matters, deadline_types, compliance_events, tasks, sub_tasks, task_comments, challan_entries, credit_notes, service_catalogue_items, client_service_assignments, client_service_prices, invoices, invoice_line_items, payment_records, documents, audit_logs.

title: Enum: StaffRole
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `StaffRole` with values: ADMIN | PARTNER | MANAGER | ASSOCIATE | INTERN. This enum represents the five staff role levels used for RBAC.

title: Enum: ModuleType
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `ModuleType` with values: CA | CS | LEGAL. This enum represents the three practice modules a firm can have enabled.

title: Enum: ClientType
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `ClientType` with values: INDIVIDUAL | HUF | COMPANY | LLP | TRUST | PARTNERSHIP | OTHER. This enum represents the legal entity type of a client.

title: Enum: TaskStatus
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `TaskStatus` with values: NOT_STARTED | IN_PROGRESS | IN_REVIEW | DONE | CANCELLED. This enum represents the lifecycle states of a task, used on the Kanban board.

title: Enum: ComplianceStatus
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `ComplianceStatus` with values: UPCOMING | IN_PROGRESS | FILED | OVERDUE | NOT_APPLICABLE. This enum represents the status of a compliance event/deadline.

title: Enum: ChallanPaidBy
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `ChallanPaidBy` with values: FIRM | CLIENT. This enum represents who paid a given government challan.

title: Enum: ChallanRecoveryStatus
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `ChallanRecoveryStatus` with values: NA | PENDING | RECOVERED | CREDIT_NOTE | WAIVED. This enum represents whether a firm-paid challan has been recovered from the client.

title: Enum: InvoiceStatus
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `InvoiceStatus` with values: DRAFT | SENT | PARTIALLY_PAID | PAID | OVERDUE | CANCELLED. This enum represents the lifecycle status of an invoice.

title: Enum: PricingType
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `PricingType` with values: FIXED | ADHOC | RETAINER. This enum represents how a client service is priced.

title: Enum: DocumentCategory
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `DocumentCategory` with values: KYC | CHALLAN | FILING | LEGAL | CORRESPONDENCE | INVOICE | OTHER. This enum represents the category assigned to an uploaded document.

title: Enum: AuditAction
content: Zynkrit defines a TypeScript enum `AuditAction` with values: CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | LOGIN | INVOICE_SENT | PAYMENT_RECORDED | TASK_STATUS_CHANGE | CHALLAN_ADDED | FILE_UPLOAD. This enum represents the action types recorded in the immutable audit log.

title: Authentication and RBAC design
content: Staff log in with email and password. The access token is a short-lived 15-minute JWT containing firmId, staffId, role, and expiry. The refresh token is stored in an HttpOnly cookie, persisted in Redis, and rotated on every use. There are five roles — ADMIN, PARTNER, MANAGER, ASSOCIATE, INTERN — and role-based access control is enforced centrally via a permissions map located at apps/api/src/lib/permissions.ts.

title: Colour token system
content: Zynkrit's design tokens: brand #6366F1 (Indigo) is used ONLY for primary actions like buttons/CTAs/active states; brand-teal #14B8A6 is used ONLY for success states like Filed/Recovered/Paid; dark #0A0F1E for marketing page backgrounds; surface #1E293B for card/panel backgrounds; border #334155 for borders and dividers; text #F8FAFC for text on dark backgrounds; muted #94A3B8 for secondary/hint text; Success #10B981 for filed/paid/completed states; Warning #F59E0B for pending/overdue/approaching-deadline states; Danger #EF4444 for errors and destructive actions.

title: Typography rules
content: Zynkrit uses Inter for all UI text, restricted to weights 400 and 500/600 only — 700 (bold) and 300 (light) are never used. JetBrains Mono is mandatory (non-negotiable) for all numbers and codes: PAN, GSTIN, CIN, BSR, currency amounts, and percentages. Serif fonts are never used anywhere in the product.

title: UI component and layout rules
content: Zynkrit UI rules: always use shadcn/ui components rather than building primitives from scratch; Tailwind CSS only, no custom CSS files; Tabler Icons in outline style at 1.5px stroke width only, never filled and never mixed with other icon libraries; border radius is 4px for tags, 6px for buttons/inputs, 8px for cards, and 12px for modals, never exceeding 12px; layout follows a 4px base spacing grid; loading states use skeleton loaders rather than spinners, with 150ms ease-out transitions; and every screen should have only one primary action — never two Indigo (brand-color) buttons side by side.

title: MVP scope — features included
content: The Zynkrit MVP includes: Dashboard, Clients (with module-specific profiles for CA/CS/Legal), Tasks with a Kanban board, Compliance Calendar, Challans and Credit Notes, Invoices and Payments, Staff Management, Documents, and Firm Settings.

title: MVP scope — explicitly excluded features
content: The following are explicitly out of MVP scope for Zynkrit and should not be built: Razorpay payment gateway integration, a client-facing portal, WhatsApp reminders via WATI, e-signature integration via Leegality, government portal sync (GST/MCA/TRACES), full-text search via Meilisearch, advanced reporting or charts, white-label subdomains, time tracking, and a mobile app.

title: Glossary term: GSTIN
content: GSTIN: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number — a 15-character identifier used for GST compliance in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: PAN
content: PAN: Permanent Account Number — a 10-character tax identification number for individuals and entities in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: CIN
content: CIN: Corporate Identity Number — a 21-character identifier assigned to registered companies in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: DIN
content: DIN: Director Identification Number — a unique identifier assigned to a company director in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: TAN
content: TAN: Tax Deduction Account Number — required for entities that deduct or collect tax at source (TDS/TCS) in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: Challan
content: Challan: A government payment receipt, used for GST, TDS, advance tax, or court fee payments in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: CIN (challan context)
content: CIN (challan context): Challan Identification Number — the reference number generated for a specific government challan payment (distinct from Corporate Identity Number). This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: BSR Code
content: BSR Code: Bank branch code that appears on TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) challans in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: SAC Code
content: SAC Code: Service Accounting Code — the GST classification code used to categorize services for tax purposes. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: CGST/SGST
content: CGST/SGST: Central GST and State GST — the two components into which GST is split equally for intrastate (within-state) transactions in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: IGST
content: IGST: Integrated GST — the GST charged on interstate (between-state) supplies in India. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: ROC
content: ROC: Registrar of Companies — the government authority in India responsible for company registration and compliance. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: MCA
content: MCA: Ministry of Corporate Affairs — the Indian government ministry overseeing corporate law and company/LLP regulation. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: ITR
content: ITR: Income Tax Return — the annual tax filing submitted to Indian tax authorities. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: TDS
content: TDS: Tax Deducted at Source — Indian tax mechanism where tax is deducted at the point of payment. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: UTR
content: UTR: Unique Transaction Reference — a reference number for a bank transaction, used to record payments. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: HUF
content: HUF: Hindu Undivided Family — a distinct legal/tax entity type recognized under Indian law. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: GSTR-3B
content: GSTR-3B: The monthly GST return summary filing in India, due on the 20th of the following month. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Glossary term: NCLT
content: NCLT: National Company Law Tribunal — the quasi-judicial body in India handling corporate law disputes and matters. This term is part of Zynkrit's India-specific compliance and legal glossary, relevant to CA, CS, and Law firm workflows on the platform.

title: Local development service ports
content: Zynkrit's local development environment uses these ports: Next.js frontend on 3000, Fastify API on 4000, PostgreSQL on 5432, Redis on 6379, Meilisearch on 7700, Mailpit (dev email capture UI) on 8025, and Prisma Studio on 5555.
